en: The front image displays a modernist hotel building labeled 'Хотел Вежен' (Hotel Vezhen) with a stepped pathway surrounded by landscaped greenery and two people walking in the foreground. The back of the postcard has text in Cyrillic and several foreign languages, indicating the location as Zlatni piassatzi (Golden Sands), a well-known resort near Varna. Additional stamps and handwritten numbers suggest archival or library collection use.
